title: Asset build spec
description: Input to a tools/blender build script. The same spec and seed always produce the same asset.

builder.description: Script in tools/blender that builds this asset, e.g. build_prop.py.

out.description: Output .glb path relative to the repo root.

pivot.description: centre: centred on x and y, lowest point at z = 0. face: the mounting face lies on y = 0 (walls, banners, lintels placed flush against a collider), centred on x only. grip: the origin is where a hand holds it (weapons), centred on x and y; the lowest point may be below zero. axis: built around the collider's axis at the origin (a round pillar, a box's centre), lowest point at z = 0; asymmetric details may move the bounding-box centre up to 15 cm off it.
